title: Mercy brings the Name home
summary: Let mercy and grace reach the heart before effort strains. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: let the mind rest on the One already carrying its life.
lifeApplication: Before you grade your progress or compare your practice, place a hand on the chest and ask gently for mercy. Let the heart become a home, not a project.

source.shortMeaning: The Name enters the mind's home through mercy, not self-mastery.
source.lifeApplication: When practice turns competitive, ask for mercy and let the heart soften.
